# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite GPU backend and Skia m152** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, built on Skia m152. It also lands async pixel readback, several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and a round of interop performance work.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to Chrome milestone m152** — Bundles the m152 engine along with merged upstream chrome/m151 and m152 bug fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds bindings for Skia's new Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and Vulkan test coverage on Android and Linux. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Async pixel readback support** — Adds a backend-neutral RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface for asynchronous pixel access. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Improved Nano Server font support** — Uses FreeType to provide font support on Windows Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free fixes** — Fixes crashes from a use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator and in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and its With* methods by properly rooting the source objects. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed** — Fixes a native memory leak on the SKImage.Create raster failure path. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Platform

- **Windows native build reliability improved** — Stops pinning a default Windows SDK version and initializes the MSVC environment once per native build, reducing native build flakiness. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz engine as part of the Skia m152 update.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced the Graphite GPU backend bindings, async pixel readback, the new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes, and updated Skia through the m151 and m152 lines.
